turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
I can certainly help you with that address change request! 🙂

To get started, could you please provide me with your order number and the email address you used at checkout?

If you don't have those handy, your phone number would also work great. ⭐️

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
I understand you'd like to cancel your order.

Due to our processing system, once an order is placed, we are unable to cancel or modify it. All sales are final, but you can find more details in our Refund Policy.

We appreciate your understanding! ⭐️

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
Once an order has been placed, we are unable to add items or make any changes to it. All sales are final, which means our system doesn't allow for modifications after checkout is complete. 🙂

If there's something else you've got your eye on, you're more than welcome to place a new order for it!
